record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Decidability of infinite local and perfect-hull extensions
record.original_question: Are the valued fields Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), and Q_p^{ab} decidable in the language Lval of valued rings? Are the positive-characteristic analogues F_p((t))^{1/p^∞} and F_p^{ac}((t))^{1/p^∞} decidable in Lval, or even in the richer language Lval(t) with a constant symbol for t?

artifact.status_search_result: Absolute (unconditional) decidability of these fields remains open, since it would imply decidability of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$, a longstanding open problem. However, partial relative results exist: via the tilting correspondence, $\mathbb{Q}_p(p^{1/p^\infty})$, $\mathbb{Q}_p(\zeta_{p^\infty})$, and $\mathbb{Q}_p^{\mathrm{ab}}$ are known to be (existentially) decidable relative to the perfect hulls of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ and $\mathbb{F}_p^{\mathrm{ac}}((t))$ respectively. Decidability of certain related perfect tame Hahn fields has been established, but full decidability of the perfect hulls of $\mathbb{F}_p((t))$ and $\mathbb{F}_p^{\mathrm{ac}}((t))$ in $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{val}}$ or $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{val}}(t)$ has not been proven.

status_evidence.title: Decidability via the tilting correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Relative decidability: Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}) and Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}) are (existentially) decidable relative to the perfect hull of F_p((t)); Q_p^{ab} relative to the perfect hull of \bar F_p((t)).
status_evidence.claim: Partial / relative decidability results are known, but absolute decidability is open.

status_evidence.title: Decidability of positive characteristic tame Hahn fields
status_evidence.snippet: Decidability for tame Hahn fields in positive characteristic via AKE-principle, including perfect hulls of related fields.
status_evidence.claim: Related perfect tame fields admit decidability results, but the perfect hull of F_p((t)) itself remains open.
